Key Predictions

What experts believe the coming decades will bring.

AGI by 2040

65%

Many leading researchers believe artificial general intelligence — systems that match or exceed human cognitive abilities — will emerge within two decades.

Medical Breakthroughs

80%

AI will enable personalized medicine, dramatically extend healthy lifespans, and potentially cure diseases currently considered incurable.

Economic Transformation

75%

AI will create entirely new industries while automating many existing jobs. The global economy could double in size by 2040.

Human-AI Symbiosis

50%

Brain-computer interfaces and AI assistants will create a new form of augmented intelligence, fundamentally changing what it means to be human.
